children: ARC Group International Ltd. disclosed a 22.7% stake in Abits Group Inc. and negotiated significant governance changes. The Schedule 13D, accepted on Sep. 09, 2026, follows an Aug. 5 closing tied to a securities purchase agreement. The deal adds two ARC-designated independent directors and signals a push for near-term transactions.

ARC Group International installed two independent directors, named a new Chief Investment Officer, and formed a two-member nominating subcommittee with authority to fill executive vacancies for 18 months. The agreement also restricts Abits Group from issuing new equity for up to six months without ARC’s consent and warns that “some or all of the above plans and/or proposals may cause the Ordinary Shares to be delisted from the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC.”

ARC aims to drive acquisitions quickly: “The Purchase Agreement anticipates that the Issuer will consummate one or more Business Acquisitions within 180 days following the Closing, or February 1, 2027.” Abits also granted CEO Conglin (Forrest) Deng a right of first refusal to buy the legacy business within nine months, with ARC’s promissory note assignment serving as consideration if he proceeds.

ARC Group International Ltd. is a Hong Kong-based investment bank and advisory firm focused on corporate finance and strategic transactions. The firm advises growth companies on mergers, acquisitions, and capital raising, often aligning its advice with direct investments. ARC works with Asia-based and global clients and seeks to add value through board-level guidance and deal execution.
